normal.question: What do reviewers say about Asana's pricing compared to Trello?
normal.expect: Asana paid plans $10.99 to $24.99 per user per month, Trello $5 to $17.50, Trello is cheaper

normal.question: How does Trello handle task dependencies compared to Asana?
normal.expect: Asana has built-in dependencies, Trello relies on third-party integrations
must_contain: While Trello offers third-party integrations for task dependencies, Asana has built-in functionality

normal.question: Who owns Trello, and which came first, Trello or Asana?
normal.expect: Atlassian owns Trello. Asana started in 2008, Trello was founded in 2011
must_contain: Founded in 2011, Trello is now owned by Atlassian, while Asana was started in 2008

normal.question: How does ClickUp's free plan compare to monday.com's free plan?

must_contain: ClickUp is more generous with their free plan

normal.question: Which tool suits an engineering team that cares about speed?

normal.question: How does Basecamp's pricing work?
